grid.origin_definition: projected coordinates of the north-west corner of cell (row 0, col 0)
grid.cell_size_note: Projected metres. Ground east-west spacing is cell_size_x_m * cos(latitude); north-south spacing equals cell_size_y_m.

aggregation.nodata_rule: a cell is missing if any of its source posts is missing (no interpolation, no partial means)

elevation.vertical_reference: Heights relative to the Mars areoid (MOLA topography 'DeltaGeoid' convention), per USGS product name and FGDC lineage

slope.method: Horn (1981) 3x3 finite differences on the 2 m grid with physical spacing
slope.formula: slope = atan(sqrt((dz/dx)^2 + (dz/dy)^2)), dx = cell_size_x_m*cos(lat_row), dy = cell_size_y_m
slope.unknown_rule: unknown (NaN) when the cell or any of its 8 neighbours lacks elevation, including the grid edge
slope.effective_baseline_note: Gradients span 2 cells (~4 m); features smaller than a few metres (rocks, steps) are not resolved.

routing.note: Cells without both ELEVATION_VALID and SLOPE_VALID are never traversable.

disclaimer: Educational Marswalk planning simulation. Real NASA/USGS terrain data; mission constraints are illustrative. Not for operational navigation.

cross_validation.affects: supplementary checks: vertical agreement with CTX and DTM-to-imagery registration (overlay display); routing uses only the DTM

checks.summary: CTX 20 m DTM minus HiRISE asset: median +0.82 m, MAD 2.18 m (USGS CTX vertical registration 3.8 m)
Mars Trek z15 tiles vs USGS 25 cm orthomosaic: +0.47 m east, +0.71 m south (correlation 0.975)
